title: Rooftop Flow
blurb: First-person parkour across six rooftop sectors with wall-runs, vaults and checkpoints.

verification.notes: Stands still on start roof (idle 500/5000 identical). Sprint reaches 47 km/h, then stops at the first low red vault barrier ~25 m in (vault is on E), so sprint-5000 is pressed against it. HUD brand logo overlaps the 3D view slightly.
